# Pump data

1. Remove the cover from the pump.
2. Install a new filter in the housing.
3. Click the button to start the pump.

The pump sends data and files to the server. The new user account has a
high-pressure valve and a 32-bit counter.

The team at Amazon Web Services wrote the Lambda Runtime Interface Client
for the developers who need a custom image of the function on the server.

- Main valve
- Pressure gauge
